## Dispatch order — the option-1 census

Epic PM for #15939, `session_015c5G6TmpMKgnusmTpD7Ntt`, 2026-09-13T22:35Z. Claim: [`5656626975`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/18078#issuecomment-5656626975). Base: `origin/main` @ `fb29f62cee`.

⛔ **Report-only. This round changes no file and opens no PR.** The deliverable is counts and enumerations posted back to this card.

---

### Zone 1 — Adjudicated. ⛔ Not re-litigable.

Decision batch #65, 2026-09-07, maintainer 「同意」 ([#15939 comment `5564447683`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/15939#issuecomment-5564447683)):

> the gate does not start reading JSDoc as a unit channel (**option 1 not adopted; its population is unmeasured**)

> Keys with no unit in either channel stay "listed, not judged" (the **#14519 shape**) — unchanged.

⇒ The number this round produces is the precondition that ruling named. ⛔ It is not this round's job to decide what to do with it, to widen the gate, to rename a key, or to propose a rule change as though it were adopted.

Also settled and ⛔ not to be reopened: `@objectstack/spec` package majors are spelled **17** in this era (`RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` is the protocol major, a different axis) — relevant only if you quote any migration prose.

---

### Zone 2 — PM mechanism assumptions. Falsify each first.

**②‑1 · ⚠️ THE CARD'S NAMED INSTRUMENT IS WRONG FOR ONE OF THE THREE SUB-POPULATIONS, AND THIS SEAT GOT THAT WRONG.** The card says use the gate's `--list` as the primary instrument and ⛔ not to hand-roll a scanner. **That is correct for A, and false for B.** Measured on `origin/main` @ `fb29f62cee`, `packages/spec/scripts/check-duration-unit-keys.ts:1061`:

```js
const durationSites = sites.filter((s) => s.proseUnits.length > 0 || s.durationShaped || s.keyUnits.length > 0);
```

`jsdocUnits` is **not** in that predicate — #17635 added the JSDoc *verdict*, not JSDoc *census admission*. So a key whose unit lives only in JSDoc, whose name carries no unit token and which `isDurationShaped()` does not recognise, **never enters the census and can never appear in `--list`**. ⇒ **A `--list`-derived zero for B is an instrument artifact, not a reading.** For B you need a source-level instrument, and the card's prohibition on writing one does not apply. Verify line 1061 yourself before relying on any of this.

**②‑2 · Sub-population A — unit named nowhere (#14519).** Duration-shaped by name token; no unit in the key name, none in `.describe()`, none in JSDoc. These **are** in the census, so `--list` is the right instrument: the rows reading `[name: -] [prose: -] [jsdoc: -]`. Seed: `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-lifecycle-advanced.zod.ts:413` `HotReloadConfig.shutdownTimeout`.

**②‑3 · Sub-population B — duration, unit in JSDoc only, outside the census.** Invisible to `--list` per ②‑1. Seeds: `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts:191` `estimatedMigrationTime` (JSDoc "Estimated migration time in hours", **no `.describe()` at all**); `packages/spec/src/system/metrics.zod.ts:847` `resolution` (JSDoc "Resolution in seconds", describe "Downsampled resolution"). ⚠️ `resolution`'s sibling at `:842` is `afterSeconds` — the suffix convention is already in use one line above, which argues oversight rather than exemption. **Note the boundary honestly**: B has no closed definition without deciding what counts as "a duration", which is part of what the maintainer is being asked. Report your inclusion rule explicitly and report the rows you judged borderline, ⛔ rather than silently picking a threshold.

**②‑4 · Sub-population C — instants as bare `z.number()` instead of `EpochMs`.** Seeds, all four verified by this seat at 19:58Z: `packages/spec/src/data/document.zod.ts:35` `createdAt`, `:402` `expiresAt`; `packages/spec/src/system/supplier-security.zod.ts:146` `assessedAt`, `:151` `validUntil` — each with "(Unix milliseconds)" in JSDoc and no unit in its describe. `EpochMs` **is** in use elsewhere (`api/websocket.zod.ts`, `kernel/context.zod.ts`, `kernel/service-registry.zod.ts`, `kernel/startup-orchestrator.zod.ts`), so this is drift from a live convention. The gate counts **6 declared `EpochMs` instants** as an exemption class — that 6 is a useful cross-check against your C count.

**②‑5 · The named non-member.** `RuntimeConfig.resourceLimits.maxMemory` (`kernel/plugin-security-advanced.zod.ts`): JSDoc "Maximum memory in bytes", describe "Maximum memory allocation". Same hazard, but a **size**. ⛔ Do not count it into A/B/C. Report separately: how many non-duration unit-bearing numerics show this shape? That number feeds a scoping question, and it needs to exist for the question to be answerable.

**②‑6 · Two seeds in this list were already wrong once.** Of the four originally carried into this work, one was a size mistaken for a duration and one was misread as already-adjudicated. ⛔ Treat every seed above as a claim to verify, not a row to copy. If a seed is wrong, say so — that is a finding, not an embarrassment.

**②‑7 · #18075 is a different gap, ⛔ do not fold it in.** It covers rows the census *does* admit (via `keyUnits`) that escape the divergence *verdict* — `latencyMs`, `frequencyHours`. Those are neither A, B nor C. If your scan surfaces more of that shape, report them under a separate heading pointing at #18075.

---

### Zone 3 — Suggested route. ⛔ Measurement beats it.

1. Worktree `objectstack-issue-18078` off `fb29f62cee`. Get `--list` runnable (`tsx packages/spec/scripts/check-duration-unit-keys.ts --list` from `packages/spec`); route any heavy build through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-18078-census`.
2. **A** from `--list`. **B** from a source-level instrument you write in the worktree and throw away — ⛔ it is not committed. **C** from a source-level instrument too, cross-checked against the gate's declared `EpochMs` count.
3. Control every count: a same-subject **lit control drawn a different way** from the measurement, and a dark control whose token you invent at read time. ⚠️ `grep -c` counts lines, not occurrences; a multi-line literal defeats a single-line `grep -o` — that exact mistake in this epic made a membership test read "no" for every token including a lit control that was visibly present.
4. Report per sub-population: **the count, the full enumeration** (`file:line` + key + what each channel says), your inclusion rule, and your borderline rows. Plus the non-member count from ②‑5, and anything ②‑7-shaped.
5. Post the report to this card. ⛔ No PR, ⛔ no branch push needed beyond your worktree, ⛔ no labels.

⚠️ **The one stop-and-report:** if you conclude a sub-population cannot be counted without first deciding a question only the maintainer can answer, **say exactly what the question is and stop on that sub-population** — ⛔ do not invent a threshold to make a number appear. A declared gap is worth more than a confident count.

---

## Instruments, and why they differ per sub-population

**Zone 2 assumption 2-1 is CONFIRMED, verbatim.** `packages/spec/scripts/check-duration-unit-keys.ts:1061` at `fb29f62cee` reads exactly as the dispatch order quoted it:

```js
const durationSites = sites.filter((s) => s.proseUnits.length > 0 || s.durationShaped || s.keyUnits.length > 0);
```

`jsdocUnits` is absent from that predicate. `--list` iterates `durationSites`, so a key whose unit lives only in JSDoc, whose name carries no unit token and which `isDurationShaped()` does not recognise, cannot appear in `--list` at any exit code. **A `--list`-derived zero for B or C is an instrument artifact.** The card's instruction to use `--list` as the primary instrument is correct for A and wrong for B and C; the dispatch order's correction stands.

| Sub-population | Instrument | Why |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A | the gate's own `--list` | A is inside the census by construction |
| B, C, D | a throwaway TypeScript instrument importing the gate's own exported `scanTree()` | reads the FULL site set (1039 numeric-chain properties) instead of the 211-row census, and reuses the gate's own `ts.getJSDocCommentsAndTags` reader, so the multi-line-literal hazard that defeats a single-line `grep -o` cannot reach it |
| controls | a perl slurp-mode regex scan over `packages/spec/src`, no TypeScript AST | genuinely different draw |

Scan surface is the gate's own: the `src/` subtree of every workspace member (2482 source files, 76-plus trees outside `packages/spec`), skipping `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `coverage`, `.turbo`, `.next`, `.cache`, and `.d.ts` / `.test.ts` / `.spec.ts` / `__tests__`. Of the 211 census rows, 209 are in `packages/spec` and 2 in `packages/drivers`. **Every row of A, B, C, D and the non-member class is in `packages/spec`.**

Baseline numbers all instruments agree on, at `fb29f62cee`, 22:37Z to 22:43Z: **1039** numeric-chain sites; **211** census rows; **828** sites outside the census; **6** declared `EpochMs` instants; **11** declared `externalVocabulary` mirrors; **419** sites with a JSDoc block; **85** sites with a JSDoc unit; zero offenders.

---

## A · unit named nowhere (the #14519 shape)

**Mechanical count from `--list`: 23.** Rows reading `[name: -] [prose: -]` with no `[jsdoc: ...]` mark. None of the 23 carries a value/unit pair, an instant mark or an `externalVocabulary` mark.

**Semantic count: 6.** The other 17 are duration-shaped *by name token* while the number itself is dimensionless — there is no unit to move into the key name, so the rule's remedy does not apply to them.

### A-true — genuine durations, unit named in no channel (6)

| file:line | key | describe | JSDoc | note |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts:311` | `duration` | none | none | `BaseResponseSchema.meta.duration`, beside a string `timestamp` |
| `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts:424` | `duration` | none | none | `FileValueSchema`, media length |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-lifecycle-advanced.zod.ts:413` | `shutdownTimeout` | "Maximum time to wait for graceful shutdown" | "Graceful shutdown timeout" | **the card's seed — VERIFIED**, `.default(30000)` |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-security-advanced.zod.ts:623` | `maxAge` | none | none (the "CORS policy" block belongs to the enclosing `cors` object and the gate correctly does not inherit it) | Access-Control-Max-Age mirror, seconds by RFC, no `externalVocabulary` declared |
| `packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts:563` | `updateAge` | "Session update frequency" | none | `.default(60 * 60 * 24)`; sibling `expiresIn` one line above has describe "Session duration in seconds" AND `.meta({ externalVocabulary: 'better-auth session.expiresIn' })` |
| `packages/spec/src/system/metrics.zod.ts:412` | `slideInterval` | none | "Slide interval for sliding windows" | sibling in the same `window` object is `durationSeconds`, "Window duration in seconds" |

### A-not-a-duration — in the census, dimensionless (17)

Counts of non-time things (11): `ai/agent.zod.ts:336 reflectionInterval` ("Reflect every N interactions"); `ai/conversation.zod.ts:152 slidingWindowSize` ("Number of recent messages to keep"); `ai/model-registry.zod.ts:46 contextWindow` and `:181 minContextWindow` (tokens); `data/driver.zod.ts:414 idle` (pool connections, beside `total`/`active`/`waiting`); `data/seed-loader.zod.ts:402 summariesStale` and `:480 totalSummariesStale`; `kernel/events/queue.zod.ts:141 snapshotInterval` ("Create snapshot every N events") and `:147 snapshotRetention` ("Number of snapshots to retain"); `system/metrics.zod.ts:224 ageBuckets` ("Number of age buckets"); `system/translation.zod.ts:1588 staleKeys`.

Dimensionless ratios (5), all `backoffMultiplier`: `integration/connector.zod.ts:442`, `kernel/events/handlers.zod.ts:48`, `shared/retry-policy.zod.ts:106`, `system/logging.zod.ts:356`, `system/worker.zod.ts:101`.

An instant, not a duration (1): `shared/connector-auth.zod.ts:38 tokenExpiry`, describe "Token expiry timestamp", no unit in any channel. It is in the census only because `expiry` is one of the 25 duration-shaped tokens. It belongs with the instants below, and it is the one instant that IS visible to `--list`.

11 + 5 + 1 = 17; 17 + 6 = 23.

### Controls on A

- **Lit, drawn a different way.** The 23 recomputed from the AST (`CENSUS(site) AND keyUnits = 0 AND proseUnits = 0 AND jsdocUnits = 0`) rather than by text-slicing `--list`: **23**, and compared as sets, `only in AST = 0`, `only in list = 0`, `SETS IDENTICAL = true`. Every one is `durationShaped`, as the 1061 predicate requires. All 23 were then read in source by hand, which is the classification above.
- **Dark, token invented at read time.** `quokkaGraceMs_zzt41`: 0 sites. The same token returns `isDurationShaped = true` (it carries the `grace` token), which is what makes the zero a reading rather than a stuck-false instrument.

---

## B · duration, unit in JSDoc only, outside the census

**Mechanical B-union-C set (jsdocUnits present AND outside the census): 7.** It partitions into 2 durations, 4 instants and 1 false positive. Sum check against the same pass: 7 outside + 78 inside = 85 sites with any JSDoc unit.

### B-true, under the inclusion rule stated below (2)

| file:line | key | JSDoc says | describe says | key name says |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts:191` | `estimatedMigrationTime` | "Estimated migration time in hours" | **no `.describe()` at all** | nothing |
| `packages/spec/src/system/metrics.zod.ts:847` | `resolution` | "Resolution in seconds" | "Downsampled resolution" | nothing |

Both seeds **VERIFIED** by direct source read, including the two details the card leans on: `estimatedMigrationTime` really has no `.describe()`, and `resolution`'s sibling at `packages/spec/src/system/metrics.zod.ts:842` really is `afterSeconds`, describe "Downsample after seconds" — the suffix convention is in use one line above, in the same object literal.

### False positive inside the mechanical set (1)

`packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-registry.zod.ts:110 downloadsLastMonth`, JSDoc "Downloads in the last 30 days", no describe. The gate's own `PROSE_COUNTED_RE` reads `30 days` as a unit; the number is a download count. Reported because any instrument built on the gate's vocabulary surfaces it, and because it would become a live false positive on the day option 1 is adopted.

### The inclusion rule I used, stated explicitly

> A numeric-chain property is in B when: its JSDoc names one of the gate's five duration units (`ms`, `seconds`, `minutes`, `hours`, `days`) in a unit-naming position as the gate's own `unitsInProse` judges it; the value is an **elapsed quantity of time** — not an instant, not a count of non-time events, not a dimensionless ratio; the key name carries no unit token; the `.describe()` names no unit; and the site is outside the census.

**Borderline rows I judged, and how:** `downloadsLastMonth` excluded (count, unit text is incidental). `estimatedMigrationTime` included even though its name is instant-shaped by suffix (`...Time`) — it is an estimate of elapsed time, not a point on a clock. `resolution` included even though its name carries no time noun at all — its JSDoc, its describe and its sibling `afterSeconds` all make it a downsampling period.

### Controls on B and C

- **Lit, drawn a different way.** A perl slurp-mode scan of `packages/spec/src` — whole-file regex, no TypeScript AST, so multi-line JSDoc blocks are matched as blocks — looking for a JSDoc naming a duration unit immediately above a `z.number` / `z.int` / `z.coerce.number` property whose key name carries no unit suffix. 40 rows, and it independently re-finds **all seven** members of the mechanical set, one occurrence each: `createdAt` 1, `expiresAt` 1, `downloadsLastMonth` 1, `estimatedMigrationTime` 1, `resolution` 1, `assessedAt` 1, `validUntil` 1.
- **Dark, token invented at read time.** `quokkaGraceMs_zzt41` reads 0 on the perl draw and 0 in every JSDoc body across all 1039 sites, against 419 sites where a JSDoc block was actually parsed and 85 where a unit was actually found — so the zero is a reading, not silence.

### The stop-and-report on B

**B is counted under the rule above. B is not closed by it.** The number 2 is "B under inclusion rule R", not "B". Two gaps make the closed count depend on a maintainer decision:

1. **The boundary itself.** Whether an interval measured in non-time units is a duration decides both A (6 versus 23) and what a JSDoc-reading widening would have to judge. I did not pick a threshold to make a number appear; I picked a rule, named it, and listed what it excludes.
2. **A JSDoc-reading widening does not reach the class below.** That is the finding this card most needs to carry forward.

---

## C · instants left as bare `z.number()` instead of `EpochMs`

**C as the card defines it (unit in JSDoc only): 4. All four seeds VERIFIED by direct source read.**

| file:line | key | JSDoc | describe |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
